text: Become aware of how your faith shapes reality. Faith is not a passive feeling, but an active creative force. Your deep, unshakable conviction that the world is arranged in a certain way - forms a corresponding reality. Want to find yourself in another reality? You do not need to work on it, invest in it, etc. - form it with your faith. "According to your faith be it unto you" - Gospel of Matthew 9:29. Technically everything is simple - you only need to sincerely believe. And yet it does not always work out, since often the "human" replaces the divine. In this case, sort out the nature of your desire to change reality (What are you running from? What keeps you in this reality?). The support is that your faith literally every moment in the form of "reality" manifests you to yourself.
